_readme: The catalogue. One entry per product; the `slug` must not change (it is the product’s web address and the key the cart and the backend use). Copy is lifted from the pouch labels. Prices and shipping rates are placeholders until Pratiti signs off — change the numbers, not the keys.

products.name: Paneer Paratha
products.tagline: Press heavier and recover smarter with our push-day-ready paneer paratha.
products.description: A classic Punjabi flatbread stuffed with spiced, protein-rich paneer. Made to be eaten like a real meal, not a supplement — and tracked like one.

products.tagline: Set a new personal record starting with lunch.
